intro: Photos I have taken. Captions are only included if there is context to add. Otherwise, the image stands on its own.
description: Not a traditional portfolio, and not necessarily a collection of perfectly planned photographs. Just places, moments, details, and ordinary things that caught my attention.
note: The gallery is organized around photographs rather than equipment or technical specifications. When there's a story behind an image, I'll add a short caption. Otherwise, I'll let the photograph speak for itself.
